specification: NB-TRANSACTIONS.csv / .xlsx: raw entries in USD dollars and FY/quarter summary normalized to USD thousands; ties exactly to F0. XLSX has formulas and two or more tabs.
derivations: Each quarter's revenue is split into three monthly sales (31%, 33%, remainder, rounded to $1,000), dated the 28th; the bank prescribes only that entries tie exactly to F0.
Only revenue entries are included: the cases using F1 (G01-G06) test revenue only.
The CSV ends with a GRAND_TOTAL row (10,000,000) so G01 can test that it is not double counted.

The XLSX has Transactions and Summary tabs; Summary uses SUMIFS formulas in USD thousands. openpyxl stores formulas without cached results, so a reader that does not recalculate sees no displayed value.
G04 mutation: NB-SALE-005 repeated exactly. G06 mutation: NB-SALE-008's quarter left blank.
